pkgmetadata.longdescription:
xterm.js 5.5.0 frontend assets for the pxvirt shell/console terminal. Provides the HTML template and pre-built JS/CSS files served by pveproxy at /xtermjs/* for host shell access and container consoles.
This package covers only the static JS/CSS frontend. The backend WebSocket proxy is sys-apps/proxmox-termproxy (a Rust binary). Both are required for a working xterm.js console in the pxvirt web UI.
Source: pre-extracted npm tarballs committed to git.proxmox.com/git/pve-xtermjs.git (xterm.js 5.5.0, addon-fit 0.9.0, addon-webgl 0.17.0).
